# @socketregistry/packageurl-js

> Socket.dev optimized package override for packageurl-js. 1 subpath exports, grouped by namespace.

Import any namespace by its subpath, e.g. `import '@socketregistry/packageurl-js/exists'`. Each link below points at the TypeScript declarations shipped in the package, where the full signature for that subpath lives.
